offering_description.value: WisdomTree manages exchange-traded funds and other investment products for individual investors, financial advisers, and institutions. It builds portfolios and packages investment strategies into exchange-listed products, tokenized funds, and private farmland investments.

primary_products.value: equity and fixed-income ETFs; commodity exchange-traded products; leveraged and inverse exchange-traded products; tokenized funds; private farmland funds

primary_services.value: investment and fund management; model portfolio services; digital asset wallet and investment platform services

customer_segment.value: B2B: Financial advisers, wealth managers, brokerages, and institutional investors; B2C: Self-directed investors and users of digital investment apps

end_markets.value: retail investing; wealth management; institutional investing; digital asset investing; agricultural real assets

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: Asset-based fees for managing exchange-traded products, tokenized funds, and private farmland investments

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Pools investor capital into exchange-traded, tokenized, and private funds for individuals and institutions; service provider: Combines investment strategies into model portfolios for financial advisers; software / platform: Gives individuals and institutions access to tokenized investments through digital platforms
value_chain_position.category: financial intermediary; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States and Europe, including the United Kingdom

specialization.value: related lines: Exchange-traded investments, adviser model portfolios, tokenized investing, and private farmland management

distribution_channels.value: other: Securities exchanges and brokerage platforms for listed investment products; partners / resellers: Financial advisers, wealth managers, and investment platforms; online: Company-operated apps and platforms for digital investments; direct sales: Institutional and adviser sales teams
distribution_channels.category: other; partners / resellers; online; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Fund management, securities issuance, and digital asset services under SEC, FCA, European, and state oversight

notes: The full scope of recent acquisitions and the current availability of digital asset services by market are uncertain.
